### ✅ PHP Function to Paginate an Array

```php
<?php
function paginateArray($array, $perPage = 10, $page = 1) {
    // Calculate the start and end index
    $start = ($page - 1) * $perPage;
    $end = $start + $perPage;

    // Return the paginated subset
    return array_slice($array, $start, $perPage);
}
?>
```

---

### 📌 Example Usage

$perPage = 5;
$page = 2;

?>
